    **Added** add new pattern variable (%SERVICE_NAME%) for stat prefix

issue: xClusterStatName new variables [closed]
**Describe the feature request**
There should be a new variables, which can be used in inboundClusterStatName/outboundClusterStatName:
%SERVICE_NAME% - Will be substituted with name of the service.
%SERVICE_NAMESPACE% - Will be substituted with namespace of the service.

It gives more flexibility in defining patterns.
